settings.title: Root to bottle.
settings.sub: BRN is the nutrition brand of Nimai Lifesciences, made in our own facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

settings.text: Every ingredient and every dose on the label. No proprietary blends. Every batch report one search away.
Ayurveda's herbs, chosen at the part of the plant that works, and made in the Himalayan foothills.
Vitamins and minerals in forms the body absorbs, dosed for the gaps Indian diets actually have.

settings.title: Chosen at the root
settings.text: Herbs picked for the part that works: kutki root, tulsi leaf, milk thistle seed.

settings.title: Grown and sourced
settings.text: Himalayan and Indian farms we can name, and minerals in the forms the body absorbs.

settings.title: Extracted and standardised
settings.text: Extracts measured to a set strength, so every batch carries the same dose.

settings.title: Tested, batch by batch
settings.text: Identity, purity and heavy metals checked before anything is bottled.

settings.title: Bottled at Nimai
settings.text: Packed in our own GMP facility at Paonta Sahib, with the batch number on every bottle.
